Thanks Karthik. Quick notes after reviewing the SOW and expected ARR profile:

- 30% rev-share is a material outlier for first-year deals in this category; it would drive down our unit economics below acceptable threshold unless paired with a higher upfront or term guarantee.
- Counter proposal: 25% rev-share year 1, 12-month commit, require Net30 OR Net60 but with an upfront 30% deposit to cover onboarding costs and an implementation milestone payment at 45 days.
- Add clause: automatic re-evaluation at renewal with a market-rate floor and no retroactive increases.

I’m attaching a redlined PrivOffer_TermSheet with track-changes on the rev-share and payment milestones. Legal will need to confirm the renewal clause language.
